input.answer: I'd go with option 1, "החברה בראש השורה". It opens straight on "עוקב מדד s&p 500", the thing my friends talk about, with every company's track and its fee listed under it, so I could see the cheapest right away (מנורה מבטחים at 0.52%, הראל and מגדל at around 0.56–0.57%). Option 3 has the "מומלץ" tag, but it's a wall of percentages and I'd close it.

stuck.where: Top tabs 1/2/3 and the green "מומלץ" on tab 3
stuck.why: At first I didn't get that these were three page designs and not filters. The "מומלץ" tag pulled me toward 3, but when I got to it, it was just a grid of numbers.
A long run of הראל tracks: כללי, הלכה, אשראי ואג"ח, אג"ח סחיר… I lost track of where the S&P was and just kept scrolling with my thumb.
Some S&P rows don't have a number at all. I wasn't sure if that's bad, or if it just means the fund is new.
Nothing next to the colours explains them. I guessed darker orange means more expensive.

The note at the bottom: "התשואה היא תשואת עבר…"

"פחות מ־3 שנים" in the return column

The coloured rings next to the percentages

findings.what: The fees are only shown as small percents (0.52%, 0.71%). Next to the huge fund sizes they all look like nothing. I'd want to see what it costs on my own amount in shekels.
Option 3 is marked מומלץ, but for me it's just a grid of almost identical percentages with no explanation of the colours. Too many things look the same, so I'd do nothing.
findings.where: Option 3, "כל החברות מול כל סוגי ההשקעה"

findings.what: Option 2 makes me scroll through 16 הראל tracks I don't care about before I reach the next company.
Some rows show "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a return, so they look worse or riskier, even אלטשולר שחם, which I know.
Lots of columns I don't understand, like the קופה number, the מט"ח percent and the rings, and they take up space on a phone.
The page is very long, and the same filter block repeats three times. On my phone I'd get lost.
There's no first step, nothing telling me what to do next once I've picked.
